entities.name: Ramón Buxarrais Ventura
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Ramón Buxarrais Ventura is a Spanish Roman Catholic prelate, who served as bishop of the Roman Catholic Diocese of Zamora in Spain from 1971 to 1973 and of the Roman Catholic Diocese of Málaga from 1973 until his resignation in 1991. He holds the title of Bishop Emeritus of Málaga.
